headlines.title: How Stablecoin Payout Launch Will Impact Visa (V) Investors
headlines.summary: Visa advanced its stablecoin strategy by moving Visa Direct stablecoin prefunding from pilots into commercial use through Inyo Global, giving eligible businesses near real time USDC prefunding options for cross border payouts alongside traditional funding.

headlines.title: Visa Direct moves stablecoin payments into commercial deployment
headlines.summary: Inyo Global became the first enabler to launch the service for eligible Visa Direct clients and partners.

headlines.title: Visa Stock Hits Fresh Record High – BMO Raises Price Target To $425 Ahead Of Earnings
headlines.summary: Visa Direct’s stablecoin-enabled prefunding capability has entered commercial production through Inyo Global, ahead of Visa’s fiscal fourth-quarter earnings report on Oct. 27.

headlines.title: Dow Jones Payments Giant Visa In Buy Zone Following This Week's Breakout Move
headlines.summary: Dow Jones payments giant Visa stock is in a buy zone following this week's breakout move despite a volatile stock market environment.

description: Visa Inc. operates as a payment technology company in the United States and internationally. The company operates VisaNet, a transaction processing network that enables authorization, clearing, and settlement of payment transactions. It also offers credit, debit, and prepaid card products; tap to pay, tokenization, and click to pay services; Visa Direct, a platform which facilitates money movement, enabling clients to collect, hold, convert, and send funds across its network; and issuing solutions, such as airport lounge access, dining reservations, shopping experiences, event tickets, and seller offers. In addition, the company provides acceptance solutions, an omnichannel payment integration with e-commerce platforms; risk detection and prevention solutions; and advisory and other services comprising consulting practice, proprietary analytics models, data scientists and economists, marketing services, and managed services. It provides its services under the Visa, Visa Electron, V PAY, Interlink, and PLUS brands. The company serves consumers, sellers, financial institutions, and government entities. Visa Inc. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
